Besides the ongoing M6 Mac mini pre-order deals, today we're also highlighting the AirPods 5 pre-order promotion (remember the AirPods Pro 3 is now only $50 more). The brand-new Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 are also available for pre-order (with some deals that can save you up to $325), and if you act fast, you can pick up the cheapest M5 MacBook Air for $1,099 through the Apple Refurbished Store ($200 off the original new price). More details below.

AirPods 5 pre-orders officially kick off, but the flagship AirPods Pro 3 is now only $50 more

Apple has officially launched the AirPods 5, and you can pre-order now starting from $129, while the higher-end version with the wireless charging case is $149. But honestly, you can now get the flagship AirPods Pro 3 through Amazon's deal for just $50 more.

Here's an overview of the pricing across the entire lineup right now:

  • AirPods 5 $129
  • AirPods 5 with wireless charging case $149
  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (originally $249)

Apple did indeed add active noise cancellation to the two new basic AirPods 5 models. However, if you want the wireless charging case and the on-stem volume controls found on the AirPods Pro 3, you'll have to go for the slightly pricier version.

The new AirPods 5 also won't give you Apple's top-tier in-ear seal and best sound isolation — that's the selling point of the AirPods Pro lineup.

Although Apple launching new AirPods with noise cancellation at $129 is indeed impressive (last year's basic version didn't have it), you really should save that $50 and not pass up the flagship Pro 3 just because the AirPods 5 are new.

The AirPods Pro 3 offers longer battery life, active noise cancellation up to 3 times stronger than the AirPods 5, heart rate sensing, and more.

Amazon has started dropping prices on Apple Watch Series 12 pre-orders

The new AirPods 5 are now available for pre-order starting from $129, and Amazon has also started slashing prices on the Series 12. While it's not a huge discount, Amazon's pricing on some Series 12 models is already lower than the competition.

Take this 42mm Series 12 GPS + Cellular model, for example — Amazon has it listed at $489.99 with shipping.

Yes, it's only $9 off, but if you're planning to pre-order before the September 18 shipping date, saving on a few coffees doesn't hurt.

Even if this isn't the configuration you're after, Amazon is very likely to slightly trim the official pricing on other models today and tomorrow (or the rest of the week).

We know this isn't exactly a massive deal, but every dollar counts, and we just want to make sure everyone's in the loop.

  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm $399

  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm GPS + Cellular $549

Act fast! The cheapest M5 MacBook Air is going for $1,099 at the Apple Refurbished Store ($200 off the original new price)

Following today's announcement of the iPhone 18 Pro, AirPods 5, and Apple Watch Series 12, the Apple Official Refurbished Store has restocked, with the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro shipping at $1,099 in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This configuration is currently the most affordable model available, and at this price, stock hasn't lasted long in recent months:

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store currently has the basic 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 512GB internal storage, listed at $1,099 with shipping. As mentioned above, at the time of writing, Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue are all still in stock.

The regular price is now $1,299, and on Amazon it's either close to that or already sold out — buying directly from Apple saves you $200.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (original new price $1,299)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

Because it's sold directly by Apple, this goes through the best refurbishment process on the market, and comes with a full warranty:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligible for AppleCare purchase
  • Sold again after Apple's rigorous refurbishment process

Apple's brand-new AirPods 5 now available for pre-order starting from $129

While the AirPods Pro 3 remains the lineup's flagship (and is currently $50 off), Apple officially unveiled the all-new AirPods 5 at its "Surprise and Shine" event, and both the basic version and the higher-end wireless charging case model are now available for pre-order.

The new AirPods 5 also come in two models this year, but this time both feature active noise cancellation. The main differences come down to price and a few key hardware features — for instance, the pricier version has an on-stem volume slider and a wireless charging case.

Key features include: a 50% improvement in noise cancellation compared to the previous ANC-equipped AirPods 4. Plus, next-generation Adaptive EQ, enhanced Spatial Audio, and up to 20 hours of battery life with the charging case.

The higher-end model also features on-stem touch controls like the AirPods Pro, longer battery life, and a wireless charging case — as the name suggests.

Brand-new Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 now available for pre-order on Amazon starting from $399

Following the brand-new AirPods 5, the all-new Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 are now available for pre-order, with shipping starting September 18.

Apple Watch Series 12

The new aluminum Series 12 lineup comes in Space Gray, Black, Light Gold, and Copper, starting from $399; the higher-end titanium versions come in Dazzling Gold and Natural, starting from $699.

Apple Watch Ultra 4

The new Ultra 4, along with a range of brand-new colorways and the gorgeous Translucent Ocean Band, is now available in Black and Natural, also priced from $799.

All-new Apple Watch band colors

  • All-new Trail Loop $99
  • Sand, Dark Brown, Burgundy
  • All-new Ocean Band $99
  • Translucent Kelp, Gray, Black
  • All-new Alpine Loop $99
  • Desert, Dark Olive, Burgundy

Both models feature an upgraded heart rate monitor that can collect data every 5 seconds and measure HRV every 5 minutes — Apple calls this the most accurate heart rate sensor ever on a wearable device.

Full-color lineup of AirPods Max 2 back in stock on Amazon, plus $100 off

Apple AirPods Pro 3 is still holding its holiday deal pricing, and Amazon has also restocked all five colors of the latest AirPods Max 2 with an additional $100 off. Since today's Apple event isn't expected to update either of these products, we can continue grabbing these still-flagship products at deal prices during this window — and it looks like this will continue into next year.

After watching some colors repeatedly go in and out of stock, Amazon has once again discounted the entire AirPods Max 2 lineup to $449 with shipping.

  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (originally $549)

Regular price $549, now $100 off — the best price we've found on brand-new units.

Today's deal matches the previous Labor Day official discount, and is the lowest price we've recorded outside of Prime Day and a brief August promotion after that.

Apple and Mr. Ternus are ready to take the virtual stage at today's big September event — stay tuned to 9to5Mac. New iPhone 18 Pro models, Apple's brand-new foldable, next-generation Apple Watch, and AirPods 5 are expected to be announced, but it looks like there won't be a next-gen announcement for the AirPods Pro 3 today (the AirPods Max 2 launched earlier).
